full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white theatrical photograph shows a man and woman close together against a pale wall filled with oversized shadows. The figures stand in the lower middle, with their bodies dissolving into the broad black area that covers the bottom of the frame. On the left, the man wears a dark suit, white shirt, and narrow tie; his dark hair is neatly combed, and he turns his face toward the camera with raised brows and a startled expression. On the right, the woman has short light hair swept back from her forehead. Her bare shoulders and pale face catch the brightest light as she leans near him, looking toward the viewer with parted lips. One raised hand appears in front of the man's chest, while another large hand-shaped shadow spreads across the wall to the woman's right. Behind the man's head, an enormous black profile and shoulder shape rises almost to the top edge, making the small figures feel threatened by their own surroundings. The wall is lit as a flat gray plane with a faint mottled surface; it is mostly empty beyond the dramatic silhouettes. Hard light comes from low front-left, striking the faces and hands and throwing enlarged, sharp-edged forms behind and to the right. The suit and lower body merge with the surrounding black, so the white faces, shirt, and wall carry the scene's strongest graphic contrast. Slight film grain and a modestly rough print surface keep the image tactile. The overall composition uses compressed figures, exaggerated shadows, and a nearly empty wall to create playful suspense with a stark low-budget stage quality.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白戏剧式照片呈现一男一女紧靠在浅色墙前，墙上布满夸大的巨型影子。两人立在下方中央，身体逐渐融入覆盖画面底部的大片黑色。左侧男子穿深色西装、白衬衫和窄领带；深发梳得整齐，他转脸朝向镜头，眉毛扬起，表情惊愕。右侧女子的浅色短发从额前向后拢。她裸露的肩与浅色面孔承接最亮的光，靠近男子，双唇微张地望向观者。一只抬起的手出现在男子胸前，而另一道巨大的手形影子在女子右边的墙上铺开。男子头后，一道巨大的黑色侧脸与肩形几乎升到顶边，使小小的人物像被周围环境威胁。墙面被照成平坦灰色，表面略有斑驳；除了戏剧性剪影外大体空白。硬光从左前低处射来，照中面孔和手，并把放大的锐边形体向后、向右投去。西装和下半身并入周围黑色，因此白脸、衬衫和墙面承载最强图形反差。轻胶片颗粒与略粗糙的印相表面保留可触感。整体构图以被压在一起的人物、夸张阴影和几乎空白的墙，营造带低成本舞台质感的俏皮悬念。
style_prompt_en: The image uses high-contrast black-and-white photography with hard theatrical lighting and exaggerated cast shadows. Black areas merge into broad silhouettes, while pale highlights isolate only a few expressive planes. Sharp shadow boundaries expand small forms across plain mid-gray space, giving the frame an intentionally constructed stage feeling. Faces and nearby details are softly grained, but the light-dark design is blunt and graphic. The composition places tight focal forms below or beside large empty areas, allowing scale changes in the shadows to carry tension. The result feels eerie, playful, and materially modest.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用高反差黑白摄影、硬朗戏剧灯光和夸张投影。黑色区域并为宽阔剪影，浅色亮部只分离少数富于表情的平面。锐利的影子边界把小形放大到素净的中灰空间里，让画面带有刻意搭建的舞台感。近处细节保有柔软颗粒，但明暗设计直截而图形化。构图把紧凑焦点放在大片空处下方或旁边，让投影中的尺度变化承担张力。结果诡异、俏皮而有朴素的材料感。
theme_en: A startled man and woman before giant theatrical shadows
theme_zh: 一男一女在巨大的戏剧性影子前惊惶回望
name: Ed Wood
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
